_note: The Blue Goose F-150 tag, 10 real phone-camera shots at varying angle/shadow/sun-glare (item #11, ARCHIVE_WEB_STREAMLIT.md). All 10 fail identically for one structural reason - these are un-cropped phone photos and ocr_common.py's preprocess_image() never crops, so pytesseract's --psm 6 can't isolate the tag text from surrounding clutter regardless of photo quality - not a per-field OCR quirk.
